paragraphs: Acusensus sells automated traffic enforcement systems to the road authorities and police agencies that are trying to cut deaths and injuries on the road network. Its main product, Heads-Up, detects drivers illegally using a mobile phone and captures evidence intended to stand up in a prosecution.

The same camera pass picks up other behaviours, so one deployment can address seatbelt non-compliance and speed measured at a point or averaged over a distance. A companion product sends live alerts to officers working the roadside. Assessment happens at the roadside, and images of drivers who are not offending are discarded almost immediately. Evidence that is kept is encrypted so that only the customer agency can open it.

The company says the government of New South Wales used its technology in a program enforcing against illegal phone use by drivers. Its list of delivered work includes an Arkansas speed enforcement program covering work zones. Acusensus also reports ISO accreditation for occupational health and safety, quality, environmental and information security management systems.

quote.text: Acusensus provides advanced traffic enforcement solutions to change behaviours and prevent road trauma.
